What is MeowTrail?

MeowTrail is a cat-themed logic puzzle game by Oakever Games, based on the classic Nikoli puzzle Akari (also known as Light Up). Your mission: place light bulbs on a grid to illuminate every white cell, following numbered clues while ensuring no two bulbs shine on each other.

Available free on Google Play and App Store.

How to Play MeowTrail

  1. Place bulbs on white cells by clicking or tapping
  2. Each bulb illuminates its entire row and column until blocked by a black cell
  3. Numbered black cells are clues — a "2" means exactly 2 of its 4 neighbors must have bulbs
  4. No two bulbs can see each other (same row/column with no black cell between)
  5. All white cells must be illuminated to win

MeowTrail Tips & Strategy

  • Start with "4" cells — all 4 neighbors must be bulbs
  • Start with "0" cells — all 4 neighbors must be empty
  • Use line-of-sight — a placed bulb eliminates all cells in its row/column
  • Count remaining spots — if a "3" has 2 neighbors blocked, the other 2 must be bulbs

Is MeowTrail free to play?

How is MeowTrail different from Sudoku?

MeowTrail uses light bulbs and illumination instead of numbers. You place bulbs so every white cell is lit, numbered black cells show adjacent bulb counts, and no two bulbs can see each other. The logic is similar but the mechanics are different.
